cues.en: Let's talk about Apache Spark and Apache Flink.
cues.zh: 來談 Apache Spark 與 Apache Flink。

cues.en: You see, before Apache Spark, usually people use Hadoop, MapReduce to process everything.
cues.zh: Apache Spark 出現以前，通常使用 Hadoop MapReduce 處理資料。

cues.en: Spark came along and actually improved the MapReduce and Hadoop by doing something called in-memory
cues.zh: Spark 出現後，透過所謂記憶體內，

cues.en: processing, which essentially allowed Spark to run processing jobs much, much faster than MapReduce.
cues.zh: 處理，改善 Hadoop MapReduce 的處理方式，讓工作執行得快很多。

cues.en: So Apache Spark became really, really popular, and it's probably the go to batch processing framework.
cues.zh: 因此 Apache Spark 很受歡迎，在錄製時，可能是批次處理框架的首選。

cues.en: So if you want to process a lot of data, well, you can use Hadoop to store that data data in HDFS
cues.zh: 要處理大量資料，可以用 Hadoop 的 HDFS 儲存，

cues.en: and use Apache Spark to run ETL jobs like extract, transform, load to clean and transform that data.
cues.zh: 再以 Apache Spark 執行 ETL，也就是擷取、轉換、載入，清理並轉換資料。

cues.en: Now, up until now, we had batch processing, which essentially means give me a chunk of data and I'll process this data over a bit of time.
cues.zh: 目前談的是批次處理，也就是給我一批資料，花一段時間處理。

cues.en: Usually you'd run a batch processing job at the end of the night and in the morning after a couple of hours, the job is done.
cues.zh: 通常晚上執行，過幾個小時，早上工作就完成。

cues.en: But as of a few years ago, the idea of real time processing started to happen.
cues.zh: 但在錄製前幾年，即時處理的概念開始興起。

cues.en: Things like spark streaming came out, which almost made real time processing possible.
cues.zh: Spark Streaming 等工具出現，讓接近即時的處理成為可能。

cues.en: That is, instead of batch processing where you waited until the end of the night to run some jobs on amount of data.
cues.zh: 不再等到晚上，才對某批資料執行工作，

cues.en: Instead, every time data comes in, you process that data in this space.
cues.zh: 而是資料一進來就處理。在這個領域，

cues.en: Apache Flink really took on the charge.
It offers real time stream processing.
Now, although Spark is still popular, tools like Apache Flink are starting to become popular now.
cues.zh: 雖然 Spark 仍很受歡迎，但在錄製時，Apache Flink 等工具也開始流行。

cues.en: This idea of streaming data and stream processing is becoming more and more popular.
cues.zh: 資料串流與串流處理的概念越來越受歡迎。

cues.en: It's still new, but there's some exciting things happening in this landscape.
cues.zh: 當時仍相當新，但這個領域正發生許多令人期待的事。

cues.en: So let's talk about that in the next video.
